query: Cold Hands Kael holds his hand over a brazier in the courtyard, and the coals grey over with frost until the fire gives up. "Where I come from, everyone learns this before they learn to read," he says. A pause. "It's for putting fires out. Mostly. I could teach you, if you wanted it." "I want it." He seems startled that you said it out loud. He takes your hands to show you, and his are as cold as ever. By the end your fingers ache and the brazier is frosted grey. "Good," he says, and doesn't let go at once. Warm his hands instead You take his hands and hold them over the last of the fire. He doesn't say anything for a long time. "Another night," he says, eventually, about the spell or the hands.
